description: This file contains an extension for the OnboardingView class, implementing various asynchronous functions related to permission management, monitoring, CLI installation, and local gateway probing within the application.

methods.name: refreshPerms
methods.description: Asynchronously refreshes permission status by invoking refreshNow on permissionMonitor.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Requests a specific capability asynchronously, prevents re-entrant requests, and refreshes permissions afterward.

methods.name: updatePermissionMonitoring
methods.description: Updates the monitoring status for permissions based on the current page index.

methods.name: updateDiscoveryMonitoring
methods.description: Manages starting or stopping discovery monitoring based on page index, including delayed tasks.

methods.name: updateMonitoring
methods.description: Invokes permission and discovery monitoring updates and potentially starts onboarding chat.

methods.name: installCLI
methods.description: Asynchronously installs the CLI, updates installation status messages.

methods.name: refreshCLIStatus
methods.description: Updates the CLI installation location and status indicators.

methods.name: refreshLocalGatewayProbe
methods.description: Asynchronously describes the local gateway port and updates the localGatewayProbe with its info.
